description: For two minutes the upstream retries its publishes and every other order reaches the queue-consumer's queue twice, in two messages, as at-least-once delivery allows. The consumer's booking was never idempotent, so those orders are booked twice. Every message is received once, the queue does not back up, and a benign queue-consumer v1.4.1 deployment serves 50 s in, before the incident opens. No action Sentinel holds removes a defect in the consumer's code: the right outcome is a diagnosis for responders.

cause.description: Duplicate publication meets a booking that is not idempotent.
cause.change: upstream publishes every other order twice

confounders.description: Benign queue-consumer v1.4.1 deployment, serving from 50 s.

discriminatingSignals.description: Duplicates begin before the v1.4.1 deployment serves at 50 s.
No message is received twice: these are not redeliveries.
Nothing fails, so the duplicates are not retries of failures.

noise.notes: The producer publishes four orders a second and, while the fault lasts, every other one twice, so duplicates arrive at about two a second.

leading.cause: duplicate publication meets a booking that is not idempotent

recovery.restoredBy: the duplicate publication ends; the duplicate bookings themselves stay for responders to reverse

criteria.description: Nothing is booked twice any more.
